title: Dynamic CV Maker: QA for live preview, styling, and export
summary: A QA study for resume builder state, ATS-friendly layout, style changes, preview accuracy, and export reliability.

sections.title: QA context from my CV
paragraphs: Dynamic CV Maker is listed as an ATS-friendly resume generator with real-time preview, dynamic styling, state management, and export functionality. This study focuses on UI state, content persistence, layout integrity, and generated output.

sections.title: Risk & proposed scope
paragraphs: Resume tools must preserve user input and export a clean document. The proposed scope tests field editing, section ordering, styling options, preview synchronization, long content, and export output.

sections.title: Example test scenarios
items: Edit a field and verify preview updates without losing other sections.
Paste long text, URLs, Unicode names, and empty optional fields.
Change style settings and verify spacing, contrast, and ATS readability.
Export the same CV twice and compare content consistency.
Reload or navigate away according to the agreed persistence rule.

sections.title: Evidence & release criteria
paragraphs: Evidence should include input data, selected template/style, preview screenshot, exported file observation, and browser. Release should block lost user content, broken export, unreadable layout, and mismatched preview/export output.
